_comment: The known ports (references for adapt, and what validate compares against). Copy to ports.json and set the paths. A port that runs ReXNative is read from its layer ("layer": its game_layer.h and d3d_surface.inc); one with its own copy of the renderer from its sources ("native", "trace", "surface"). Each also needs its ReXGlue generated code and the game's default.xex. Paths are only read.
